Wayne Local school dates per The Spartan (September and October 2026) and the district Community Events & Activities newsletter (October 2026) and Board Meeting Recap (October 2026). Mary L. Cook Public Library programs per the library's monthly newsletter (November 2026). Recurring items (rodeo, commissioners, ghost walk) show the next occurrence. Warren County Park District events page SUSPENDED as a source per Cap'n (2026-10-03): it sits behind a Cloudflare bot challenge (403 since 2026-09-24). Do not fetch it or report it as failing; its items from the 2026-09-23 check are kept until they expire. Resume only when Cap'n provides a working source. Event notes and dateLabels are shown to readers: write them for readers (what, when, where, and a helpful pointer like "check the event website for times" when a detail is missing). Never put editorial or process notes in them ("not published", "confirm before printing", "corrected from", "checked on"); record corrections in the commit message instead. Tag Christmas-season community events (tree lightings, Santa visits, holiday markets, single-date light shows) with "holiday" so they also appear on the Holiday Lights guide. Waynesville area vs. regional: an event counts as Waynesville-area when its venue names Waynesville, Corwin, Harveysburg, Oregonia, Ridgeville, Lytle, Mount Holly, Crosswick, Caesar Creek or ZIP 45068/45054/45065 (see src/lib/events.js); always put the town in the venue. Set "local": true or false to override (e.g. an online survey about Waynesville, or an out-of-town group serving Waynesville families).

items.title: Waynesville Fantasy Festival
items.note: Third annual free, family-friendly celebration of all things fantasy: LARP training grounds and an archery contest, birds-of-prey encounters, a fire performance, live music, a cosplay competition, riddle trivia, a halfling tea party, a walking-staff competition, a quest, and a beer garden. Check the festival listing for the day's schedule.

items.title: Business to Business Networking — November
items.note: Waynesville Area Chamber of Commerce Business to Business networking mixer. Check the Chamber events page for details.

items.title: Little Miami Scenic Trail
items.note: ~78-mi paved rail-trail — biking, hiking, running

items.title: Kings Island
items.dateLabel: Bonus Weekend Nov 7–8; WinterFest select nights Nov 27–Dec 31
items.note: Park hours: Nov 7–8 Bonus Weekend 11 AM–7 PM. WinterFest opens Nov 27 (Nov 27 & 29 5–10 PM, Nov 28 4–10 PM) and runs select nights through Dec 31. Waterpark closed. Check the park calendar for any changes.

items.title: WinterFest at Kings Island
items.note: Per Kings Island: holiday event on select nights. Opening weekend hours Nov 27 & 29 5–10 PM, Nov 28 4–10 PM. December open dates on the park calendar: Dec 4–6, 11–23 and 26–31; check the calendar for each night's hours.

items.title: Wayne Local Schools Board of Education — Regular Meeting & Spartan Recognition Awards
items.venue: WLS Performing Arts Center (Auditorium), 625 Dayton Rd, Waynesville
items.note: Per Wayne Local Board Meeting Recap (Oct 2026): the bi-annual Spartan Recognition Awards ceremony opens the meeting, followed by a short break and the regular business meeting. Open to the public.

items.title: Gingerbread 101 Workshop
items.venue: Mary L. Cook Public Library, 381 Old Stage Rd, Waynesville
items.note: The Waynesville Area Arts Council hosts a gingerbread-making workshop at the library. Register in person at the library; a cash deposit ($10 per person, or $20 for a group of 2–4) is collected at sign-up and refunded at the workshop. Children must be accompanied by an adult.

items.title: Christmas in the Village
items.note: Fri 1–9 PM (shops open 11 AM), Sat noon–8 PM, Sun 11 AM–4 PM. Santa arrives by fire truck at the Gazebo on Main Street (Fri 6 PM, Sat 1 PM); heated entertainment tent and strolling characters; Sunday Holiday Christmas Market Street Faire with the Parade of Santas at 1 PM.

items.title: Christmas Book Flood PJ Storytime
items.venue: Mary L. Cook Public Library, 381 Old Stage Rd, Waynesville
items.note: An evening storytime for all ages, in pajamas, celebrating Iceland's "Jolabokaflod" (Christmas Book Flood) tradition. Children take home a book and a hot cocoa packet. No registration required.

items.title: Service Dog Storytime
items.venue: Mary L. Cook Public Library, 381 Old Stage Rd, Waynesville
items.note: Stories about service dogs, plus a chance to meet a working service dog and its handler.

items.title: Friends of the Library Holiday Auction
items.venue: Mary L. Cook Public Library, 381 Old Stage Rd, Waynesville
items.note: Bid in person on holiday gift baskets, decorations and other items donated by area businesses and neighbors. Bidding opens Friday, Nov 20 at noon and closes Thursday, Dec 10 at 7:00 PM. Proceeds from the Friends of the Mary L. Cook Library support the library’s free programs for all ages and its new Playscape.

items.title: Letters to Santa mailbox at the library
items.venue: Mary L. Cook Public Library, 381 Old Stage Rd, Waynesville
items.note: Drop letters to Santa in the library's special mailbox. Letters mailed by Dec 15 get a reply from Santa's elves, who try to answer before Dec 25.

items.title: Santa Holiday Open House at the Library
items.venue: Mary L. Cook Public Library, 381 Old Stage Rd, Waynesville
items.note: Photos with Santa, letter writing, a holiday craft, the library's new Elf Academy, and refreshments from the Friends of the Library. Registration required, beginning Monday, Nov 9: call the library at 513-897-4826 or sign up at the front desk.

items.title: North Warren County Transportation Plan — online survey closes
items.note: Last day to comment online on the plan, including options for a new I-75 to I-71 connection (one would follow US 42 and S.R. 73 through Waynesville and Corwin) and priority intersections such as S.R. 73 and US 42 in Waynesville. The survey opened Oct. 28.

items.title: Hearthwarming Holidays
items.dateLabel: Fri–Sun, Nov 6–8 · Fri & Sat 11 AM–8 PM, Sun noon–5 PM
items.note: Holiday open house weekend in the downtown shops; collect recipe cards as you stroll from shop to shop. Free admission.

items.title: Town Square Days: Step into Stars Hollow
items.note: "A Day in Waynesville": downtown Waynesville steps into Stars Hollow for the weekend, 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. both days, rain or shine. Presented by the Waynesville Merchant Association and sponsored by Taylor's Coffee & Creamery. See the flyer, or the merchants' events calendar at waynesvilleshops.com.

items.title: Waynesville Christmas Rewind
items.note: A nostalgic Christmas evening downtown: shop local for last-minute gifts, hot cocoa, Christmas music and classic-Christmas-movie fun. Free, no tickets needed.

items.title: Free Thanksgiving food baskets for Waynesville families
items.note: MorningStar Baptist Church is offering Thanksgiving food baskets to Waynesville families who could use a little extra help this year. To ask for one for yourself or someone you know, text 937-270-2330, email Outreach@morningstardayton.org or message the church on Facebook.

items.title: Warren County Commissioners — Weekly Session
items.note: Weekly commissioners session; agendas and minutes posted online

items.title: Holiday Jingle Mingle — Chamber Business to Business Networking
items.note: The Waynesville Area Chamber of Commerce holiday networking mixer. Check the Chamber events page for details.

items.title: Town Square Days Dance Marathon
items.venue: Turn Out Dance Academy, 274 S. Main St., Waynesville
items.note: A public dance marathon with a 1940s theme (plus some 2000s music) during Town Square Days. No dance experience needed; prizes for one couple and one single winner. Entry is two canned goods or a $5 donation for the Waynesville Food Pantry. Arrive by 11:15 AM; no shoes in the studio, and a short waiver is required.

items.title: The City Mercantile Christmas Market
items.dateLabel: Fri–Sun, Nov 13–15 · Fri 10 AM–3 PM, Sat 10 AM–4 PM, Sun 10 AM–3 PM
items.venue: Warren County Fairgrounds, 665 N. Broadway, Lebanon
items.note: Per the organizer: holiday vintage, handmade and boutique market. Admission $12 Friday, $10 Saturday, $5 Sunday; children 12 and under free. Discounted tickets online in advance.

items.title: What’s next for Waynesville’s roads? — County Engineer on the North Warren County Transportation Plan
items.venue: Village of Waynesville Office, 1400 Lytle Rd, Waynesville
items.note: Free community meeting. Warren County Engineer Kurt Weber will talk about the North Warren County Transportation Plan and the I-75 to I-71 route option through town. RSVP to the Waynesville Area Chamber of Commerce at 513-897-8855. Can’t make it? The county’s online survey is open through Nov. 17.

items.title: CrossView Christmas Bazaar
items.dateLabel: Fri–Sat, Nov 6–7 · Fri 3–7 PM, Sat 9 AM–4 PM
items.venue: CrossView Christian Church, 4237 E. Social Row Rd, Waynesville
items.note: Christmas gift bazaar with vendor tables at CrossView Christian Church. See the flyer for details, or visit the church’s website, crossview.cc.

items.title: Dessert Auction for the Miami Cemetery Association Roads Fund
items.venue: CrossView Christian Church, 4237 Social Row Rd, Waynesville
items.note: Bid on cakes, pies, cookies and other baked goods. All proceeds go to the Miami Cemetery Association Roads Fund, a nonprofit. See the flyer for details, or visit the church’s website, crossview.cc.

items.title: Donations wanted for the Friends of the Library Holiday Silent Auction
items.venue: Mary L. Cook Public Library, 381 Old Stage Rd, Waynesville (front desk)
items.note: The Friends of the Mary L. Cook Library are collecting items for their Holiday Silent Auction (Nov 20 – Dec 10): gift baskets, gift certificates, wreaths, quilts, wood crafts, toys, candy, jewelry, Spartan wear, home and bath products, baked goods, bikes, grills, camping gear and more. Drop donations at the library’s front desk Nov 9–14, or ask at the desk about a pickup. Proceeds support the library’s free programs and its new Playscape.

items.title: Waynesville Lions Club Pancake Breakfast & Craft Bazaar
items.dateLabel: Sat, Dec 5 · Breakfast & Santa 8–11 AM, bazaar 8 AM–3 PM
items.venue: Waynesville Elementary School, 659 Dayton Rd, Waynesville
items.note: The Lions Club’s annual breakfast and bazaar. Pancake breakfast 8–11 AM ($8 adults, $5 children) and visits with Santa 8–11 AM; craft bazaar with 30 vendors 8 AM–3 PM, free admission. New this year: a free children’s crafting table, live performances by local children, and a free raffle for a basket worth over $300 (visit all 30 vendor booths to fill your card). All proceeds benefit the Waynesville Food Pantry.

items.title: Playoff football, Round 2: Waynesville vs. Preble Shawnee
items.note: Second-round OHSAA playoff game hosted by Waynesville, which had a first-round bye. OHSAA sets ticket prices: adults $12, students $5. Cash is taken at the gate; to pay by card, buy online through OHSAA (student tickets go on sale online after 4 PM Nov 6). Waynesville athletic passes and senior passes are not accepted for playoff games.

items.title: Playoff football, Region 20 semifinal: Waynesville at Graham
items.note: Division V, Region 20 semifinal. Waynesville (9-2) beat Preble Shawnee in Round 2 and travels to Graham in St. Paris. Kickoff time is from MaxPreps; OHSAA sets playoff ticket prices and sells tickets online, so check OHSAA before you go.

items.title: American Legion Post 615 Annual Veterans Day Dinner
items.note: Post 615 invites all veterans and Legion members to its annual Veterans Day dinner. Check with the post for the location and any RSVP.

items.title: Lebanon Horse-Drawn Carriage Parade & Christmas Festival
items.dateLabel: Sat, Dec 5 · festival 10 AM–8 PM; parades 1 PM and 7 PM
items.note: Ohio’s largest horse-drawn carriage parade returns to downtown Lebanon, with two parades (1:00 and 7:00 p.m., the evening one by candlelight) and a Christmas festival and market from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m., per the Lebanon Area Chamber of Commerce.
